# OmopBridge

[![R-CMD-check](https://github.com/oxford-pharmacoepi/OmopBridge/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/oxford-pharmacoepi/OmopBridge/actions/workflows/R-CMD-check.yaml)
[![Codecov test
coverage](https://codecov.io/gh/oxford-pharmacoepi/OmopBridge/graph/badge.svg)](https://app.codecov.io/gh/oxford-pharmacoepi/OmopBridge)

OmopBridge lets you save named database configurations in a user-level
`.Renviron` file and create an OMOP CDM connection from a key.

## Installation

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("oxford-pharmacoepi/OmopBridge")
```

## Example

Set up a PostgreSQL configuration once. The password is prompted for
when it is omitted and is not printed by the package.

``` r

library(OmopBridge)

setupDatabaseKey(
  key = "postgres_omop",
  dbms = "postgres",
  server = "localhost",
  database = "omop",
  uid = "my-user",
  cdmSchema = "cdm",
  resultsSchema = "results",
  achillesSchema = "achilles"
)
```

Create the CDM reference whenever it is needed:

``` r

cdm <- cdmFromKey("postgres_omop")
```

Configurations can be inspected without exposing the password:

``` r

databaseConfig("postgres_omop")
```

For SQL Server, provide an explicit catalog for each schema:

``` r

setupDatabaseKey(
  key = "sql_server_omop",
  dbms = "sql server",
  server = "sql-server",
  database = "connection_database",
  uid = "my-user",
  cdmCatalog = "omop",
  cdmSchema = "dbo",
  resultsCatalog = "results",
  resultsSchema = "dbo",
  achillesCatalog = "results",
  achillesSchema = "achilles"
)
```

The `.Renviron` file contains credentials and should never be committed
to version control.

# Package index

## All functions

- [`cdmFromKey()`](https://oxford-pharmacoepi.github.io/OmopBridge/reference/cdmFromKey.md)
  : Create a CDM reference from a saved database key
- [`databaseConfig()`](https://oxford-pharmacoepi.github.io/OmopBridge/reference/databaseConfig.md)
  : Read a saved database configuration
- [`setupDatabaseKey()`](https://oxford-pharmacoepi.github.io/OmopBridge/reference/setupDatabaseKey.md)
  : Save a database configuration under a named key
